title: Perfect for those who dont have a sense of time!
body:
I’ve known this app since iPhone 5 was the second latest model. But it was only recently that I really got into using this app. 

My usage of it is mainly to track when was the last time I did something. 

As someone who usually feels 3 days pass by as just 1 day for me, even when I’m busy, or 5 days pass by when it’s only been 2 days, this is a perfect app to get me in shape, to remind me that I need to be doing this again because self care or it’s something I do periodically. 

It’s been a real help since, thank you so much!
